query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.machine_requests (id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY, shop_id UUID REFERENCES public.shops(id) NOT NULL, status TEXT DEFAULT CHR(112)||CHR(101)||CHR(110)||CHR(100)||CHR(105)||CHR(110)||CHR(103) CHECK (status IN (CHR(112)||CHR(101)||CHR(110)||CHR(100)||CHR(105)||CHR(110)||CHR(103),CHR(102)||CHR(105)||CHR(108)||CHR(108)||CHR(101)||CHR(100),CHR(112)||CHR(114)||CHR(111)||CHR(99)||CHR(101)||CHR(115)||CHR(115)||CHR(105)||CHR(110)||CHR(103),CHR(115)||CHR(104)||CHR(105)||CHR(112)||CHR(112)||CHR(101)||CHR(100),CHR(100)||CHR(101)||CHR(108)||CHR(105)||CHR(118)||CHR(101)||CHR(114)||CHR(101)||CHR(100))), plan_name TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), full_name TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), phone TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), address TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), city TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), state TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), zip_code TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), logo_url TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), needs_logo_design BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, notes TEXT DEFAULT CHR(39)||CHR(39), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); ALTER TABLE public.machine_requests ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
